name: rungic-docker
depends: docker.io, docker-compose-v2, rootlesskit, slirp4netns, uidmap, iptables, util-linux, procps, rungic-plasma-config
description:
Plasma Mobile on Android: rootless Docker
Docker runs per user in rootless mode inside the container, which shares Android's network
without net_admin; Settings -> Services turns it on. Needs the container config's TUN device
and nesting mounts (plasma.config). See docs/85-lxc-rootless-docker.md.
